_read: OpenRouter GET /api/v1/videos/models + /openapi.json (VideoGenerationRequest, InputReference), free reads 2026-11-20, trimmed

request.input_references_note: Reference assets to guide video generation. Accepts image, audio, and video references. Audio and video references are only honored by providers that support them (including BytePlus Seedance generation 2 and newer); other providers use image references and ignore the rest.
request.provider_options_note: Provider-specific options keyed by provider slug. The provider segment is case-insensitive; an endpoint tag after `/` must match the endpoint slug exactly. Only options for the matched provider are forwarded; the rest are ignored. Unrecognized keys are silently dropped.
